🔊 Getting a Flemish voice

Every 🔊 button reads the Dutch text aloud using your browser's built-in text-to-speech — free, no account, no app needed. It automatically tries a Flemish (Belgian Dutch) voice first, and falls back to whatever Dutch voice your device has if it doesn't have one.

📱 Android (Chrome)

Settings → System → Languages & input → Text-to-speech output → ⚙️ next to "Google Text-to-Speech Engine" → Install voice data → Dutch → download Nederlands (België) if it's listed.

🪟 Windows

Settings → Time & Language → Speech → Manage voices → Add voices → search Dutch (Belgium).

🍎 iPhone / iPad / Mac

Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices → Dutch → pick a Belgium voice if offered.

Not every device offers a Belgium-specific voice — if yours doesn't, the app will just use whatever Dutch voice is available instead.
